display_title: DIGITAL-ECCC-2027-DEPLOY-CYBER-11-AI4SME Strengthening cybersecurity capacities of European SMEs with cybersecure AI-powered solutions – Digital Europe Programme
call_title: Strengthening European Cybersecurity Technologies, Capacities and Preparedness (DIGITAL-ECCC-2027-DEPLOY-CYBER-11)
call_module_title: DIGITAL-ECCC-2027-DEPLOY-CYBER-11-AI4SME Strengthening cybersecurity capacities of European SMEs with cybersecure AI-powered solutions
executive_summary: Funds the development, adaptation, validation and uptake of AI-powered cybersecurity products, tools and services for European SMEs, in particular a SaaS toolkit for risk management, threat detection, incident response and incident reporting. Legal entities established in an EU or EEA country and not controlled from outside them are eligible; SMEs, start-ups, research, the public sector and NIS 2 entities are targeted. SME Support Actions at 50%, or 75% for SMEs; EU contribution expected at EUR 3–5 million per project, EUR 20 million for about 5 projects; indicative duration 36 months. Opened 1 September 2026; single-stage deadline 14 January 2027, 17:00 CET.
status_rationale: The call document (DEP 11, pp. 14-17, AI4SME Objectives and Scope) funds AI-powered cybersecurity toolkits and services that automate risk management, threat detection and incident reporting for SMEs. Compared with the project files, only TwinEU deals with cybersecurity, and it concerns grid-wide data federation and resilience, not generic tools for small companies; the topic names no energy, operational-technology or critical-infrastructure application, so as a general cybersecurity call it does not touch TenneT's field.
